eli-cust: Hey support — we're seeing the API return a structured output parse failure in strict mode for one of our endpoints. Happens intermittently when price fields are returned as quoted numbers. Sample error: 

{"error":"structured_output_error","code":"invalid_type","path":"$.items[0].price","expected":"number","got":"string","request_id":"rq_61f2..."}

julia-support: Thanks @eli-cust — can you paste the exact request (headers + body) you used and which model + mode? Also include the request_id from the error (you posted it, good).

eli-cust: curl snippet below (sanitized):

```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"open-seq-7b","mode":"json_schema","json_schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"price":{"type":"number"},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["pending","complete","failed"]}}}}}},"input":"...","seed":42}'
```

eli-cust: Response (truncated):

```json
{"error":{"message":"invalid_type at $.items[0].price: expected number got string","request_id":"rq_61f2...","code":"structured_output_error"}}
```

julia-support: Got it. Two quick clarifying Qs: 1) Are you sending the model any additional system instructions that might force numeric values into quotes? 2) Do you have `strict` mode enabled (we call it `strict_json: true` in SDK)?

eli-cust: We don't send system-instructions to coerce types. We do have strict_json = true in our SDK config. Example SDK payload (python):

```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key='sk-REDACTED')
resp = client.generate(model='open-seq-7b', mode='json_schema', json_schema=SCHEMA, input=prompt, strict_json=True)
```

samir-eng: tagging in — thanks for the detailed repro. Common root causes: 1) Model emits numbers as strings (e.g., "123.45") when doing textual reasoning, 2) Enum casing mismatch (e.g., "Pending" vs schema "pending"), 3) explicit null/boolean confusion ("null" as string).

maria-api: I pulled the logs for request_id rq_61f2... — we got several spans where the structured parser rejected the model output. The model output contains "price":"12.00" (quoted). Our strict parser does not coerce string->number when strict_json is true.

eli-cust: Is there a recommended mitigation? We need strict mode for downstream validation but can't have the call fail every time the model quotes a number.

julia-support: Options: 1) Turn off strict_json for this route and run your own post-parse validation and coercion (safer if you can tolerate small mismatches). 2) Keep strict_json and send a stronger output-conditioning instruction to the model asking it to emit bare numbers and exact enum casing. 3) Use the `coerce_types` beta flag (eng has an internal toggle) — it'll attempt non-destructive coercion (strings that parse as numbers -> numbers, case-insensitive enum matching) but it's not GA and has edge-cases.

samir-eng: For us to evaluate enabling `coerce_types` for your org we need: the failing model output, ~5 repro examples, and confirmation that coercion won't break downstream systems. If you prefer we can also add a targeted fallback that tries to coerce only numeric-looking strings into numbers and lowercases enums before strict parse (narrow scope).

eli-cust: Attaching two short failing generations (copied raw):

```
{"items":[{"id":"a1","price":"12.00","status":"Pending"},{"id":"a2","price":15.5,"status":"complete"}]}

{"items":[{"id":"b3","price":"0","status":"failed"}]}
```

eli-cust: Also we do some telemetry downstream that expects enums in lowercase exactly, so casing coerces would be safe for us. Numbers must be numeric types.

maria-api: Noted. I've flagged the request and added a tag for `coerce_types` evaluation. @samir-eng can you review potential side effects on analytics pipelines?

samir-eng: Will do. Quick note: coercion of "0"->0 is safe typically, but be careful with leading zeros or padded strings. Also if the model outputs arrays as strings ("[1,2]") we don't want blind eval(). We'll scope to primitive number/boolean/null coercion and enum case folding.

julia-support: For immediate workaround until eng decides: 1) Add a lightweight post-processor that scans the JSON string and converts numeric-looking quoted tokens to numbers and lowercases enum tokens in the expected enum keys, then validate against schema. 2) Or change strict_json to false and use our server-side "schema_validation" webhook with a tolerance policy.

eli-cust: We'll implement a short post-processor while you evaluate `coerce_types`. One more question: would switching to a different model variant help? We are on open-seq-7b, can moving to the 'instruction-tuned' variant reduce quoted numbers?

maria-api: Yes, instruction-tuned variants tend to follow formatting constraints more reliably. If you can test `open-seq-7b-instruct` and paste a couple outputs we can compare.

ops-bot: [automated] ticket SUP-7382 created and assigned to eng-ml (samir-eng). Priority: P2.

samir-eng: I'll take SUP-7382. Next steps: 1) run a quick A/B with instruct variant, 2) review logs for similar customer repros, 3) prototype `coerce_types` narrow-scope fallback and run integration tests. ETA 48-72h.

eli-cust: Thanks all — appreciate the quick help. I'll add the two failing samples to the ticket and test the instruct model. :thumbsup:
